hero.description: Your wealth deserves expert care. With nearly two decades of experience, WealthKare helps you make smarter financial decisions with confidence and trust.

services.subtext: From mutual funds to unlisted equities, we offer every solution your wealth journey needs — all under one trusted roof. Eight services. One relationship.

items.description: Professionally managed, diversified portfolios — built around your goals, reviewed regularly, and distributed through Regular Plans only.
Individually managed equity portfolios for investors with ₹50 lakhs and above — direct ownership, transparent reporting, active strategy.
Institutional-grade alternative strategies — private equity, real estate, and hedge funds — accessible to qualified investors.
Fixed-income instruments from rated issuers — predictable cash flows, capital preservation, and yields that outperform conventional deposits.
Higher-yield fixed deposits from NBFC and corporate issuers — better returns on your fixed-income allocation without equity risk.
Pre-IPO and unlisted equity opportunities — early access to companies before they list, with asymmetric return potential for informed investors.
Protection that complements your wealth — term cover, health insurance, and general insurance structured to safeguard what you've built.
Home, car, and personal loans facilitated through trusted banking and NBFC partners — liquidity solutions when you need them.

testimonials.headline: In Their Words
testimonials.disclaimer: Testimonials reflect individual client experiences and are not indicative of future results.

items.quote: I am using your services for more than 10 years now and am quite happy with your services. My most of life savings are in financial assets under your management. I really need a good guide and a person who is reliable, proactive and handles the investments methodically. Financial investment guide need to think above his interest of commission — which I found with you. I also feel comfortable to discuss difficult issues regarding security of investments with you. I have already given your reference to all my family members and close friends — which itself is the biggest testimony from my side. Please continue to give professional and honest help to the society.
items.author: Mr. R. C. Gupta

items.quote: I am a client of Wealthcare for the last 8 years! My whole family is a client and Mr. Naveen Gupta has been handling our portfolios. I am very pleased with their on time and honest services. The best part is the honesty, which always puts me at peace that my life savings are in safe hands. I have always received honest and beneficial financial advice from Wealthcare and their team.
items.author: Mr. Akshay Gupta

items.quote: I would like to acknowledge and express my appreciation for their useful advice and impeccable service in handling my investment portfolio. WC Securities have been providing me financial advice and services since past 8 years and I am very much satisfied with them. Their professional dealing along with attention to detail with which they have handled my financial affairs could not be faulted. Particularly reassuring to me is the feeling of trust and credibility along with absolute integrity of their dealings with me.
